de.abas.erp.db.selection

Interface Selection<T extends SelectableRecord>

  • Type Parameters:
    T - The type to select.
    All Known Subinterfaces:
    RowSelection<HEAD,ROW>

    public interface Selection<T extends SelectableRecord>
    Selection instance represents a selection of object in the database. The type of the objects and a selection String must be provided. Database queries can be created by creating an DatabaseIterator instance while giving an instance of this class as parameter.

    • Method Summary

      All Methods Instance Methods Abstract Methods 
      Modifier and Type Method and Description
      String getCriteria()
      Returns the Abas specific selection string for this selection.
      TableDescriptor getTableDesc()

      Class<T> getType()

    • Method Detail

      • getTableDesc

        TableDescriptor getTableDesc()
        Returns the table descriptor. The table descriptor may be null if getType() returns a meaningful value. More precise, if getType() returns a generated schema class. If the table descriptor is not null it is used to execute the database query. If it specifies an exactly one schema object it is used to find the correct result type. e.g. for table description 4:23 the result type will be an instance of the generated interface of V-04-23.
        Returns:
        the table descriptor

      • getType

        Class<T> getType()
        Returns the result type of this selection. Must be a subtype of SelectableRecord but not SelectableRecord itself.
        Returns:
        the type of this selection.

      • getCriteria

        String getCriteria()
        Returns the Abas specific selection string for this selection. Selection information that is hidden in the selection type of this selection is not allowed. Therefore \@group,\@zeilen will throw an InvalidQueryException.
        Returns:
        Returns the bas specific selection string for this selection.
